licence.scope: NASA website media usage guidelines (owner's website terms, option 2; the page does not serve the curves). They cover NASA images, audio, video and media files, not filter-transmission tables explicitly; they say such NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the US and asks that NASA be acknowledged. SVO cites the Nimbus 5 User's Guide on docserver.gesdisc.eosdis.nasa.gov (NASA GES DISC); no GES DISC-specific statement was fetchable with curl (disc.gsfc.nasa.gov/information/data-policy returned an empty page). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
